mapper.select: SELECT bracket_id AS bracketId, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, lower_bound AS lowerBound, upper_bound AS upperBound, tax_rate AS taxRate, progressive_deduction AS progressiveDeduction, created_at AS createdAt FROM gift_tax_bracket ORDER BY effective_from DESC, lower_bound ASC

SELECT deduction_limit_id AS deductionLimitId, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, relation, is_minor AS isMinor, deduction_limit AS deductionLimit, created_at AS createdAt FROM gift_deduction_limit ORDER BY effective_from DESC, relation ASC, is_minor ASC

SELECT bracket_id AS bracketId, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, lower_bound AS lowerBound, upper_bound AS upperBound, tax_rate AS taxRate, progressive_deduction AS progressiveDeduction, created_at AS createdAt FROM gift_tax_bracket WHERE effective_from = #{effectiveFrom} ORDER BY lower_bound ASC

SELECT deduction_limit_id AS deductionLimitId, effective_from AS effectiveFrom, effective_to AS effectiveTo, relation, is_minor AS isMinor, deduction_limit AS deductionLimit, created_at AS createdAt FROM gift_deduction_limit WHERE effective_from = #{effectiveFrom} ORDER BY relation ASC, is_minor ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gift_tax_bracket (effective_from, effective_to, lower_bound, upper_bound, tax_rate, progressive_deduction) VALUES (#{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{lowerBound}, #{upperBound}, #{taxRate}, #{progressiveDeduction})
INSERT INTO gift_deduction_limit (effective_from, effective_to, relation, is_minor, deduction_limit) VALUES (#{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{relation}, #{isMinor}, #{deductionLimit})
mapper.sql: law_id AS lawId, law_code AS lawCode, law_key AS lawKey, law_name AS lawName, law_type AS lawType, ministry, promulgation_no AS promulgationNo, promulgation_date AS promulgationDate, effective_date AS effectiveDate, unit_type AS unitType, article_no AS articleNo, article_key AS articleKey, title, article_effective_date AS articleEffectiveDate, content, revision_history AS revisionHistory, latest_revision_date AS latestRevisionDate, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt

where.if: AND ( law_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR article_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT law_code AS lawCode, law_name AS lawName, law_type AS lawType FROM law_article ORDER BY law_name ASC
